original_query: select     w_state   ,i_item_id   ,sum(case when (cast(d_date as date) < cast ('1998-04-26' as date))  		then cs_sales_price - coalesce(cr_refunded_cash,0) else 0 end) as sales_before   ,sum(case when (cast(d_date as date) >= cast ('1998-04-26' as date))  		then cs_sales_price - coalesce(cr_refunded_cash,0) else 0 end) as sales_after  from    catalog_sales left outer join catalog_returns on        (cs_order_number = cr_order_number         and cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk)   ,warehouse   ,item   ,date_dim  where  i_item_sk          = cs_item_sk  and cs_warehouse_sk    = w_warehouse_sk  and cs_sold_date_sk    = d_date_sk  and d_date between  (cast ('1998-04-26' as date) - interval '30' day)                 and (cast ('1998-04-26' as date) + interval '30' day)   and i_category  = 'Home'  and i_manager_id between 28 and 67  and cs_wholesale_cost between 69 and 88  and cr_reason_sk = 11  group by     w_state,i_item_id  order by w_state,i_item_id limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH date_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(CASE WHEN d_date >= DATE '1998-03-27' THEN d_date_sk END) AS start_sk,
        MAX(CASE WHEN d_date <= DATE '1998-05-26' THEN d_date_sk END) AS end_sk,
        MIN(CASE WHEN d_date >= DATE '1998-04-26' THEN d_date_sk END) AS threshold_sk
    FROM date_dim
)
SELECT
    w.w_state,
    i.i_item_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cs.cs_sold_date_sk < db.threshold_sk
             THEN cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)
             ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cs.cs_sold_date_sk >= db.threshold_sk
             THEN cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)
             ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN catalog_returns cr
  ON cr.cr_order_number = cs.cs_order_number
 AND cr.cr_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
 AND cr.cr_reason_sk = 11
JOIN item i
  ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN warehouse w
  ON w.w_warehouse_sk = cs.cs_warehouse_sk
CROSS JOIN date_bounds db
WHERE cs.cs_sold_date_sk BETWEEN db.start_sk AND db.end_sk
  AND i.i_category = 'Home'
  AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 67
  AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 69 AND 88
GROUP BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id
ORDER BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: The LEFT OUTER JOIN to catalog_returns is null-rejected by the WHERE predicate `cr_reason_sk = 11`, so it can safely be converted to an INNER JOIN with `cr_reason_sk = 11` pushed into the JOIN's ON clause.

Remove redundant `cast(d_date as date)` and `cast('1998-04-26' as date)`; d_date is already of DATE type and the literal is already a date, so the casts are unnecessary and prevent sargable date comparison.

Fold the interval arithmetic into concrete DATE literals: `1998-04-26 - 30 days = 1998-03-27` and `1998-04-26 + 30 days = 1998-05-26`. This avoids the implicit date->timestamp cast produced by `date - interval` and makes the predicate sargable on the DATE column.

The date_dim join is used only for filtering and the CASE split, not for any output column. It can be eliminated by resolving the date range and threshold into d_date_sk values via a tiny one-row CTE, replacing the join with direct range comparisons on catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk (which is indexed).
